title: Correctness of a gate gadget
statement: For natural numbers $n,c$, a predicate $Q$ on gate kinds and input arities, a predicate $P$ on gates, and an emitter that assigns an output vertex and a list of gates to each gate and existing gate list, gadget correctness means the following: for every gate $g$ and gate list $G$ that is acyclic on $n$ inputs, if every argument of $g$ is a vertex among the $n$ inputs and the vertices of $G$, and $Q$ holds for the kind of $g$ and its number of arguments, then the emitter's result satisfies the gadget specification with depth overhead $c$, size allowance $\operatorname{arity}(g)+2$, and new-gate predicate $P$.
hypotheses_covered: Predicates $Q$ on gate kind and arity, and $P$ on gates
An emitter from a gate and gate list to a gate list and output vertex
Acyclicity of the existing gate list
Every gate argument is less than $n+|G|$
$Q$ holds for the gate kind and argument count
caveat: The supplied declaration does not include the definition of the gadget specification, so its precise required properties cannot be stated from this payload alone.
